main.description: Claim a full sites domain (e.g. alice.tngl.io) for the authenticated user. A claim is one per account. tngl.sh handles require confirmation from the handle authority and cannot be released.

domain.description: Full domain to claim, e.g. alice.tngl.io. Label rules: 1-63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphen.

errors.name: DomainTaken
errors.description: That domain is already claimed by another user.

errors.name: DomainCooldown
errors.description: That domain was recently released and is in a 30-day cooldown period.

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.description: You already have a domain claimed. Release it before claiming a new one.

errors.name: InvalidSubdomain
errors.description: The domain label or TLD is invalid.

errors.name: HandleNotOwned
errors.description: The handle authority identifies a different account.

errors.name: HandleUnknown
errors.description: The handle authority does not know this handle.
